name: Memory Management Specialist
description: Master manual memory management, dynamic allocation, pointer arithmetic, and ownership tracking. Build custom allocators and data structures from scratch.
dictum_features: handle to bytes with room for
example_snippet:
program BufferDemo:
    keep Buffer as handle to bytes with room for 1024

    unsafe:
        keep Ptr as * byte
        put transmute Buffer as * byte into Ptr
        put 65 into Index at 0 of Ptr
    end unsafe

    print the text "First byte: " and Index at 0 of Buffer and newline
    release Buffer
end program
